Molecular preparation with Chimera

> Current preparation guide; its historical URL has been preserved.

Active path

Receptor and ligand preparation uses UCSF Chimera. Controls expose solvent and hydrogen removal, hydrogen addition, gas or am1 charges, minimization and cofactors. Receptor and ligand settings are independent. Open Babel applies pH during conversion; pH is not a Chimera template argument. This guide describes the current code and provides no alternative backend setup.

Entry points

OperationImplementationPurpose
Standalone preparationwrappers.redocking.prepare_structuresReceptors and candidates for Vina, DOCK6 or both
Redockingwrappers.redocking.perform_redockingExplicit pairs, preparation and RMSD with Vina or DOCK6 6.11
Vina dockingwrappers.docking.perform_docking_vinaCandidates and receptor, reusing compatible prepared structures
DOCK6 dockingwrappers.docking.perform_docking_dock6Candidates, receptor, spheres, grids, docking and footprint
Consensuswrappers.docking.generate_consensusCombine scores for compound/receptor pairs present in both engines

biomolexplorer.redocking_config validates pairs and applies template options. biomolexplorer.redocking_preparation isolates pair failures and reuses receptors. biomolexplorer.docking_preparation prepares candidates and validates receptor formats. The docking backend is implemented in src/caad/docking.py.

Resources and results

Preparation templates live in src/biomolexplorer/resources/chimera/:

TemplateResponsibility
prepare_complex.templateSelect chain and cofactors for the working complex
prepare_receptor.templatePrepare the receptor and export MOL2 and PDB without H
prepare_ligand.templateSeparate and prepare the reference ligand as PDB and MOL2
prepare_better_conform.templatePrepare a conformation for the DOCK6 protocol

Open Babel produces formats such as PDBQT. Centers and metadata identify the binding site. Reused receptors must contain the formats required by the engine: Vina requires PDBQT; DOCK6 also uses MOL2 and PDB without H. The SES surface is computed by biomolexplorer.molecular_surface using NumPy and SciPy and written in the format consumed by sphgen. No standalone DMS executable is needed.

Execute and diagnose

Connect receptor and compounds to Prepare for docking.
Choose the engine and review receptor and ligand settings.
Run and inspect prepared files, centers and metadata.
Connect outputs to the corresponding engine and inspect its results.

Chimera and protocol executables must be accessible to the worker. Command failures retain diagnostic information; inspect stage logs before changing parameters. Cancellation stops scientific processes. Files alone do not establish chemical validity: assess structures, RMSD and scores against suitable study references.

See installation, redocking, user manual and molecular surfaces.
